title: A binary adder by hand

milestone.title: Binary: The Language of the Machine

description:
Add two binary numbers written as text, column by column, without converting them.

```
  1011
+  110
------
 10001
```
hints: `a.zfill(n)` pads with zeros on the left so both strings have the same length.
For each column, the digit is `(x + y + carry) % 2` and the carry is `(x + y + carry) // 2` (lesson 2.05).
requirements: Read two strings of 0s and 1s; refuse anything else.
Add from the right with a carry, like pencil-and-paper addition. Do not use `int(x, 2)` for the sum.
Print them right-aligned with the line between them, then check the answer with `int(..., 2)`.
stretch: Subtract too, by adding the two's complement.
